lemmas.primary_translation: begin to grow vigorously / emerge and grow / come into a state of thriving or well-being

definitions.translation: begin to grow vigorously (lit. blossom up)

examples.no: algene blomstret opp som følge av mye næring i vannet
examples.en: the algae flourished as a result of abundant nutrients in the water

examples.no: kriminaliteten har blomstret opp i byene
examples.en: crime has flourished in the cities

definitions.text: komme i en tilstand av trivsel, velvære eller lignende
definitions.translation: come into a state of thriving, well-being, or the like
